channel.title: Days Since Ohio Crash
channel.description: Tracking every incident where a car has driven into a building in the Columbus, Ohio metro area. Sourced. Verified. Satirical. Currently: 3 day(s) since last incident.

item.title: Car plows into Dublin Chipotle, driver reportedly "missed the drive-thru"
item.description: Car plows into Dublin Chipotle, driver reportedly "missed the drive-thru" — The guac survived. The storefront did not. Investigators confirm the queso was at fault. | Sawmill Rd Chipotle, Dublin OH | via NBC4i Columbus

item.title: Vehicle crashes into Dollar General on East Broad, third such incident at this location
item.description: Vehicle crashes into Dollar General on East Broad, third such incident at this location — This Dollar General has now been hit more times than its clearance sale items. It has achieved three-star crash status. | E Broad St Dollar General, Columbus OH | via WBNS 10TV

item.title: Car crashes through Westerville Walgreens storefront; pharmacist reportedly unfazed
item.description: Car crashes through Westerville Walgreens storefront; pharmacist reportedly unfazed — The pharmacist filled two more prescriptions before calling 911. True professional. | State St Walgreens, Westerville OH | via Columbus Dispatch

item.title: SUV crashes into Polaris Panera; 'You Pick Two' now includes structural damage
item.description: SUV crashes into Polaris Panera; 'You Pick Two' now includes structural damage — Staff continued making souffles. No soup was harmed. The bread bowl held its shape better than the wall. | Polaris Pkwy Panera Bread, Columbus OH | via ABC6

item.title: Vehicle crashes into Gahanna AutoZone — staff immediately offered to check the airbags
item.description: Vehicle crashes into Gahanna AutoZone — staff immediately offered to check the airbags — Poetic. A car. Into a car parts store. The universe has a sense of humor and it is Ohio. | N Hamilton Rd AutoZone, Gahanna OH | via Columbus Dispatch

item.title: Car crashes into Hilliard Kroger entrance; shopper says it was 'the most exciting thing to happen in Hilliard since 2019'
item.description: Car crashes into Hilliard Kroger entrance; shopper says it was 'the most exciting thing to happen in Hilliard since 2019' — Store remained open. Self-checkout lanes unaffected. The car is now in produce. | Cemetery Rd Kroger, Hilliard OH | via WBNS 10TV

item.title: Pickup truck drives through Pizza Hut on Morse Rd; delivery was still on time
item.description: Pickup truck drives through Pizza Hut on Morse Rd; delivery was still on time — The driver may have confused 'hot and ready' with 'floor it.' Stuffed crust undamaged. | Morse Rd Pizza Hut, Columbus OH | via NBC4i Columbus

item.title: Car drives into Short North CVS; driver cited, CVS receipt still longer than the police report
item.description: Car drives into Short North CVS; driver cited, CVS receipt still longer than the police report — The receipt for the repair estimate was 47 feet long. CVS brand. | High St CVS, Columbus OH | via Columbus Dispatch
